python_requirement: CPython 3.12 or 3.13, Windows AMD64; wheels lists publisher hashes for both supported interpreters

packages.name: huggingface-hub
requires_dist: hf-xet<2.0.0,>=1.4.3; platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "amd64" or platform_machine == "AMD64" or platform_machine == "arm64" or platform_machine == "aarch64"

integrity_note: Every selected wheel uses the SHA256 published by PyPI or the official PyTorch CUDA12.6 index. All selected packages were checked against public PyPI advisory metadata at capture time; this is not a guarantee that unknown vulnerabilities are absent.
validation: Isolated Windows CPython 3.12 and 3.13.15 installations; pip check; synthetic Real-ESRGAN, Places365 and Qwen video inference passed. Python 3.13.15 also passed fresh setup and forced package repair in a folder containing spaces and literal brackets. No FPV accuracy claim.
